note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation), nominations 5 January, poll Thursday 15 January 1925. Eleven members were returned unopposed and four wards (Court, Dock, Falls and Smithfield) were contested; the Socialists (Labour) gained Dock and Smithfield (Belfast News-Letter, 6 and 16 January 1925). Hall replaced the retiring member, W. C. Bickerstaff, who did not stand again.
